findings.finding: OPA1678 on single 5.1 V: at 0 dBFS the + input peaks at 3.05 V vs common-mode limit V+-2 = 3.10 V; output swings 0.92..4.18 V vs 0.8..4.3 V. Distortion near full scale; margin negative below 5.03 V supply.
findings.fix: R73, R75, R81, R83 1.5k -> 1.3k 0402 1% (gain 0.463): CM peak 2.75 V (0.35 V margin), output +/-1.41 V (0.34 V margin), 0 dBFS = 1.00 Vrms -> 63 W/4 ohm, 1.0 dB below clip.
findings.margin: input CM 48 mV (1.6 %), output 0.12 V each side

findings.finding: Proposed loopback switch (second TS5A23157) on the RCA side would switch LDIV, which is ground-referenced (0 V DC, +/-0.92 Vpk with FLX4 2.1 Vrms): below the switch's 0..V+ signal range; body diodes conduct, distorting the ADC and DJ-direct paths.
findings.evidence: SCDS165F 6.5 analog range 0..V+, abs min -0.5 V; LDIV = 2.1*1.414*0.311 = 0.92 Vpk
findings.fix: Switch biased nodes: NC = LSW_x (2.55 V via R102/R112), NO = tap -> 1 uF -> node with 100k to VREF, COM -> C101/C111 -> AINxP. Range 2.55+/-0.92 V and 2.55+/-0.80 V inside 0..5.1 V.
findings.margin: proposed as drawn: -0.92 V vs 0 V min (negative); fixed: >= 1.63 V

findings.finding: Proposed loopback switch select from a 3.3 V ESP32 GPIO or ES9018K2M GPIO2 cannot reach TS5A23157 VIH = 0.7*V+ = 3.57 V at 5.1 V; ES9018 GPIO is tri-stated during RESETB low (select floats).
findings.evidence: SCDS165F 6.5 VIH V+*0.7; ES9018K2M v3.7 p.9 standby tri-states GPIO
findings.fix: Add an S8050 (C2146) inverter as Q6: 10k base, 10k pull-up to +5VA, 100k base pull-down so default = RCA.

findings.finding: SDZ driven from GPIO21 (3.3 V) through R54 100k. SLOS708G allows IIH up to 50 uA; above 13 uA SDZ falls below VIH 2.0 V and the amp never leaves shutdown.
findings.evidence: SLOS708G 6.3: VIH 2 V, IIH 50 uA max; 3.3 V - 50 uA*100k = -1.7 V (worst case), needs I <= 13 uA
findings.fix: R54 100k -> 22k (C31850): 2.2 V at 50 uA; ESD-diode injection with PVDD off <= 150 uA. Bench: measure SDZ voltage with GPIO high.
findings.margin: worst-case -1.7 V below VIH; typical likely positive (unverified)

findings.finding: ES7243E coupling 1 uF into 8 kohm: -3 dB at 19.9 Hz (~25 Hz with X5R bias) on the line-in -> ADC -> DSP -> subs path.
findings.evidence: ES7243E rev 5.0 input impedance 8 kohm (0 dB PGA); fc = 1/(2*pi*8k*1u)

findings.finding: ES8388 full-scale 1 Vrms at 0 dB volume vs TPA3118 26 dB input clip 0.623 Vrms (20 V, 4 ohm): 0 dBFS overdrives by 4.1 dB; FLX4 via analog bypass at 0 dB overdrives by 2.1 dB.
findings.evidence: ES8388 rev 5.0 FS out AVDD/3.3; power.py; SLOS708G eq. 2
findings.fix: Firmware cap LOUT1/ROUT1 vol at -4.5 dB and LI2LOVOL at -3 dB, or 20 dB gain (R50 5.6k, R51 DNP).

findings.finding: Line-in headroom with FLX4 (2.1 Vrms rated, <=1 kohm source): 0.79-0.84 Vrms at LIN1 vs 1.0 Vrms FS; ES8388 PGA cannot attenuate.
findings.evidence: ratio (10k||20k)/(1k+10k+6.67k) = 0.377; Pioneer DDJ-FLX4 spec MASTER 2.1 Vrms/10 kohm
findings.fix: R30, R33 10k -> 15k 0603 1 % (JLC basic; LCSC number not yet picked): 0.62 Vrms, -4.2 dBFS.

findings.finding: TPA3221 inverts; DAC path pre-inverted in U11 but DJ-direct path is not, so in DJ mode mains are inverted vs the PCM5102A sub (fed via ADC): cancellation at crossover.
findings.evidence: SLASEE9C 9.2.1.2 'The device inverts the audio signal'; 6.5 'Inverting voltage gain'
findings.fix: Firmware: invert sub/ADC polarity while DJ_DIRECT=1.

findings.finding: DJ_DIRECT toggle pop: MAIN DC = VREF + up to ~50 mV (806 ohm +/-11 % and 1 % resistor mismatch) vs LSW = VREF; x15.85 = ~0.8 V step at the speaker.
findings.fix: Firmware: RESET both amps low (20 ms ramp), switch, release both in one TCA9555 port-0 write (also needed for controller/peripheral sync, SLASEE9C 8.3.2).

findings.finding: ES9018K2M MCLK 50 MHz equals the maximum with internal DVDD; oscillator tolerance can exceed it.
findings.evidence: ES9018K2M v3.7 p.9 DVDD supply, p.31 note 2
findings.fix: 49.152 MHz 3225 oscillator (ASRC mode; 192 kHz needs >36.9 MHz).

findings.finding: FREQ_ADJ 2x100k 1 % = 50k +/-1 %; ROC 49.5-50.5k: no margin before TCR.
Open-load LC resonance +38..+40 dB at 50-73 kHz; core 4.7 ohm + 1 nF snubber gives no damping at f0.
findings.evidence: sims/audio lc_*_open: hpk 38.2-40.3 dB, f0 50.3-72.6 kHz
findings.fix: Optional DNP Zobel footprint per leg; check 'speakers off' loopback captures for ringing.

findings.finding: Loopback tap scale: loaded ratio Lite 0.0625 (not 1/11), core 0.0276 (not 1/16); one leg includes PVDD ripple/2 and common-mode products.
findings.evidence: ES8388 Zin 20 kohm, ES7243E Zin 8 kohm
findings.fix: Firmware scales by loaded ratio, one-time calibration; single-leg THD is an upper bound.
findings.margin: Lite -7.6 dBFS, core -11 dBFS at full power

findings.finding: DJ-direct max with FLX4 at rated 2.1 Vrms: 0.65 Vrms at amp = ~27 W/4 ohm (4.7 dB below clip); FLX4 load 7.0-7.3 kohm vs 10 kohm rated.
AMP_IN_R crosses BUCK3_LX on the other layer (0.21 mm offset), AMP_IN_L 1.25 mm from it; driven from low-Z ES8388 LOUT so low risk.
Continuous full power 2x79 W (core 4 ohm 28 V) needs ~176 W in vs 140 W PD; TPA3221 RthJA 44.8 C/W without heatsink.
findings.fix: Power/thermal reviewers; firmware governor must limit.

findings.finding: Pop sequencing: +3V3A collapses before PVDD on unplug; amp must wait for VMID (10 uF, tau 0.5 s at 50k).
findings.evidence: ES8388 rev 5.0 VMIDSEL; 690 uF PVDD bulk
findings.fix: Firmware: SDZ low on VBUS_SENSE drop; SDZ high >= 2.5 s after VMID enable.
